description: This file contains the definition of the Startup class within the Opencart Admin Model setting namespace. The class provides CRUD operations for managing startup entries in the database, including adding, deleting, updating status, and retrieving startup data.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Model class for managing startup configurations in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: addStartup
methods.description: Inserts a new startup record into the database with the provided data.

methods.name: deleteStartup
methods.description: Deletes a startup record from the database based on startup_id.

methods.name: deleteStartupByCode
methods.description: Deletes a startup record from the database based on the startup code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a startup entry identified by startup_id.

methods.name: getStartup
methods.description: Retrieves a startup record by its startup_id.

methods.name: getStartupByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a startup record by its code.

methods.name: getStartups
methods.description: Fetches a list of startup records with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalStartups
methods.description: Returns the total count of startup records in the database.
